channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Palestine weekly: Israel kills dozens in Gaza after Hamas disarmament deal
item.description: Israeli strikes on Gaza only intensified in the days following a US-brokered agreement billed as a 'breakthrough'.

item.title: US stocks near record high, oil falls as Trump claims Iran talks under way
item.description: Benchmark S&P 500 approaches all-time peak as Washington, Tehran offer conflicting accounts of status of talks.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran slams US blockade as Trump warns of ‘last chance’
item.description: US president says talks with Iran are under way, warning the negotiations are Tehran's 'last chance' to secure a deal.

item.title: Five dead in Moscow region as Ukraine continues warehouse strikes
item.description: Facilities in St Petersburg and Tver were also hit, while at least one was killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine.

item.title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
item.description: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

item.title: US reports first two deaths linked to 'explosive diarrhoea' outbreak
item.description: The illness caused by parasitic infection that spreads through contaminated food or water is not generally life-threatening, health officials say.

item.title: Did Iran hack water systems in seven US states?
item.description: While US President Donald Trump has said Iran is not to blame, cyber experts tell the BBC it likely the attack was at the hands of the Iran.

item.title: At the scene of deadly Moscow bomb blast
item.description: Three people have been killed and 21 injured after an explosive device detonated at an Italian restaurant, Russian media reports.
